regions.note: City plus outskirts: the BBMP area (about 77.46-77.78, 12.83-13.14) widened to whole tenths so it takes in the airport, Nelamangala, Hoskote, Electronic City and Anekal. No contours: a city does not need them, and it keeps the download small.
